rattle.title: Mtoto wa Rottle
rattle.descTemplate: Sauti ni miongoni mwa sauti za kale zaidi. Katika ZZCOUNTRY, {civ} walezi kwa muda mrefu muhuri mbegu au pebbles katika gourd, udongo, vikapu, au kuni kwa malipo ya mtoto kufahamu na rhythm. Rattle ni toy ya hisia na, katika baadhi ya maeneo, sauti ya charm ya kinga. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Hollow rattle with seeds, pebbles, or bells

whistle_toy.title: Toy au Toy
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Vivumishi vidogo - udongo wa umbo la ndege, mbao za kuchonga, zimeonekana tena katika masoko na tabaka za akiolojia zilizofungwa kwa maisha ya {civ} katika {country}. Watoto hutumia kama toys za kuongeza sauti; baadhi ya mara mbili kama kelele za tamasha. Sauti kucheza kufundisha pumzi na lami playfully.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Wanyama wa kipenzi
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wanyama Wheeled na pull-along takwimu ni kumbukumbu kutoka zamani classical kupitia vijiji woodcrafts katika {country}. {civ} artisans sura farasi, ndege, au ng'ombe kwamba kufundisha kutembea toddlers kuhusu traction na ushirikiano katika mwendo.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: Jinsi ya kupanda au kupanda mimea ya wanyama

mini_weapons_toy.title: Toy upinde au dart kucheza kuweka
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Vifaa vya uwindaji vilivyopimwa vinaruhusu watoto katika ujuzi wa {country} rehearse unaoadhimishwa na watu wazima wa {civ} -archery, mishale ya miiba, au lengo la blowpipe - kwa kutumia vifaa salama. Malengo juu ya majani, kuni, au miduara inayotolewa kugeuka martial mbinu katika kucheza alifunga.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Nguvu ya chini au ya chini ya toy bow/darts

jacks_local.title: Vifaa vya mikono
jacks_local.descTemplate: Zaidi ya familia ya knucklebones iliyoshirikiwa, {country} ina mlolongo wa ujuzi wa ndani wa mawe na ulioundwa na utoto wa {civ} - kutupa tofauti, nyimbo, na ngazi za ugumu kwenye kanuni hiyo ya pickup, iliyorekodiwa hapa kama kuingia kwa mazoezi ya kikanda wakati nyimbo na mlolongo ni tofauti nchini.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Hadithi nyingi / kuchora mchezo
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Kupiga kura kwa zamu, kupoteza, au hadithi ya kuchochea inaonekana katika mikutano ya {civ} katika {country}. Ikiwa fimbo za mianzi, knucklebones, au dice iliyochorwa, nafasi huchagua ambaye anaongea, kucheza, au majibu - toy ya kijamii kwa makali ya ubashiri na mchezo wa chama.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Takwimu za mchezo
shadow_play.descTemplate: Kivuli kucheza-mkono wanyama au vikaragosi ngozi-amewakaribisha usiku katika {country} ndani ya hadithi ya {civ}. Mwanga na silhouette hugeuka ishara katika ukumbi wa michezo. Baadhi ya mikoa iliinua hii katika sanaa rasmi za puppet; vivuli vya mkono wa watoto vinabaki fomu ya toy.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Nyumba ya Sanaa
kite_local.descTemplate: Wakati kuruka kite ni familia moja ya kimataifa, {country} ya {civ} ya watengenezaji maendeleo maumbo tofauti, karatasi, bridles, na matumizi ya tamasha. Kuingia hii inaonyesha kwamba utamaduni wa ufundi wa ndani kama mazoezi ya kite ya kikanda chini ya anga pana ya kite.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Mavazi ya Doll
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: dolls laini wamevaa katika mwelekeo wa nguo za ndani kuonekana katika kaya za {civ} katika {country}. Embroidery, mavazi ya kufunika, na hairstyles hupunguza mavazi ya watu wazima. Kujali kucheza kunafundisha majukumu ya kijamii; mbinu za hila hupita kati ya vizazi.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Kuvaa nguo au kuficha mpira
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Kabla ya mpira wa viwanda, jamii za {civ} katika {country} zimefunikwa na mipira ya kushona kutoka kwa ngozi, nguo, au fiber ya kupanda. Catch, kick, na michezo ya mzunguko ilikua karibu vitu hivi. Mpira ni kama utamaduni kama sheria.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: Home › Mafunzo › Top Craft
top_local.descTemplate: Juu ya kucheza ni ya zamani na ya kimataifa; hii rekodi ya kuingia {country} {civ} mitindo ya carving, vifaa vya ncha, na mashindano etiquette kama mazoezi tofauti ya ufundi na kucheza ndani ya toy hiyo ya fizikia iliyoshirikiwa.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Takwimu za Mitaa
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} takwimu kamba wanaohusishwa na {country} kubeba majina ya mitaa, wanyama, na hadithi hata wakati ufunguzi inafanana utoto wa paka mahali pengine. Takwimu ni michoro ya portable ya hadithi na kumbukumbu ya mkono.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Bodi ya mbio za watu (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Mzunguko na mzunguko wa mbio za barabara huonekana katika nchi nyingi. Katika ZZCOUNTRY, wachezaji wa {civ} walitumia shells, fimbo, au knucklebones kwa alama za mbio nyumbani-cousins kwa miundo kama pachisi lakini kwa maumbo ya kufuatilia ya ndani na desturi za mahali salama zilizorekodiwa kama bodi ya jamii ya kikanda. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Wilaya ya Mkuranga
sowing_local.descTemplate: Ambapo sowing michezo alichukua mizizi katika {country}, {civ} bodi kuonyesha tofauti kikombe hesabu, sheria relay, na maumbo ya mbao. Wao ni wa familia ya mancala lakini wanastahili maingilio ya kikanda wakati geometry ya bodi na mila ya kukamata ni kawaida.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Kombe la Dunia au Kombe la Dunia

jump_rope.title: Michezo ya Skiing
jump_rope.descTemplate: Skipping na kuruka-rope rhymes kustawi katika shule ya {country} na mitaa ndani ya utamaduni wa utoto wa {civ}. Solo hatua kasi na kundi la muda mrefu-rope michezo kushiriki rhythm bouncing; nyimbo localize toy.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Rope ya hemp, plastiki au mzabibu

blindfold_tag.title: Mbadala majina ya mtu / wito michezo
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfolded kutafuta michezo-call-na-dodge variants-kuonekana katika vyama vya {civ} na mikutano ya watoto katika {country}. Sauti, utulivu, na huruma kwa mchezaji kipofu muundo furaha.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Michezo kwa ajili ya vijana
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Vijana mieleka michezo kujiandaa kwa ajili ya watu wazima mitindo sherehe na jamii {civ} katika {country}. Matoleo ya kucheza yanasisitiza kutupa salama, mipaka ya mzunguko, na kicheko juu ya kuumia-michezo kama toy ya kijamii.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Wimbo wa kumbukumbu / download
memory_song.descTemplate: Kuondoa nyimbo na nyimbo za kumbukumbu - sawa na 'ambaye bado' michezo ya mzunguko - ni toys ya rhythm na tahadhari katika utamaduni wa mdomo wa {civ} katika {country}. Maneno mabaya au kushindwa hupunguza wachezaji mpaka mmoja abaki.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Kuweka mipaka au kuweka mipaka
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts kuonekana kama vifaa vya tamasha na toys usawa wa watoto katika {country}. Waumbaji wa {civ} wanainua walkers kwenye mianzi, kuni, au makopo yaliyorejeshwa. Racing na Trick-stepping kugeuka mwinuko katika kucheza.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: Vipande vya vitunguu au tin-can stilts

leaf_boat.title: Mpira au mpira wa kikapu
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Jamii ndogo ya mashua kwa kutumia majani, gome, au corncobs furaha watoto karibu na maji katika {country}. {civ} kucheza zamu mikondo katika nyimbo na ufundi katika majaribio ya uhandisi.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: majani, gome, au cork kwa hulls

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / snow takwimu kucheza
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Sculpting takwimu za muda mfupi katika mchanga au theluji ni ujenzi wa msingi kucheza popote {civ} mandhari katika {country} kutoa kati. Kasri, wanyama, na aina za mababu zinaonekana na kupotea-architecture kama toy ya ephemeral.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Mpira wa miguu / mpira wa karatasi
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick michezo kwamba simulate mpira wa miguu / soccer juu ya meza kuenea kupitia shule katika {country}, layered juu ya wakubwa kidole-flicking toy tabia katika {civ} utoto. Malengo ni vitabu au machapisho yaliyochorwa; mashindano yanaweza kuwa makali.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.
req: Coin, button, au mpira wa karatasi

riddle_local.title: Kubadilishana kwa sakafu
riddle_local.descTemplate: Kubadilishana kati katika {country} kuhifadhi sitiari ya {civ}, ikolojia, na ucheshi. Kupiga na kutatua chini ya shinikizo la muda ni toy ya akili ambayo haihitaji vifaa vya viwandani.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Michezo ya Kubahatisha Toy
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Tamasha noisemakers-ratchets, clappers, bell-sticks-let watoto kujiunga {civ} rites ya umma katika {country}. Volume na rhythm alama ya kalenda wakati; baadhi ya toys ni msimu na kuhifadhiwa baadaye kama gear ya ibada.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bell stick, clapper, au ngoma toy

puzzle_knot.title: Kucheza mchezo Puzzle Toy
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: puzzles Disentanglement ya kamba, pete, na kuni kuonekana kama toys soko na weusi curiosities karibu {country}. Wachezaji wa {civ} wanajifunza topolojia kwa kugusa-kutoa pete bila kulazimisha, kisha reassemble.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Nyumba ndogo ya kucheza
mini_house.descTemplate: Vifaa vya kaya vidogo - pans za pwani, mikufu ya kusuka, samani za doll - kusaidia jukumu la kucheza kwa maisha ya watu wazima wa ndani katika utoto wa {civ} katika {country}. Archaeology na ethnography wote wanapata toys hizi za kufundisha.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

game-0001.description: Chess ilibadilika kutoka chaturanga, vita-simulation ya watoto wachanga, cavalry, tembo, na magari. Kama ilisafiri kupitia Uajemi (shatranj) katika ulimwengu wa Kiislamu na Ulaya ya zama za kati, vipande vilikuwa safu za mahakama. Malkia wa kisasa na mamlaka ya askofu crystallized mwishoni mwa Ulaya medieval. Tamaduni zote zimesimama kwa akili, maono, na burudani ya elimu.
howToPlay: Kukubaliana bodi hivyo kila mchezaji ana mwanga wa mraba kwenye kona ya mkono wa kulia.
Weka vipande kwenye cheo cha nyuma (rook, knight, askofu, malkia juu ya rangi yake, mfalme, askofu, knight, rook) na pawns kwenye cheo cha pili.
Kwanza, wachezaji hubadilishana kipande kimoja (isipokuwa wakati wa kutupwa).
Wakati huo huo, ni wakati wa kupata Wakati huo huo, ni wakati wa kupata
Tumia hatua maalum wakati wa kisheria: castling, en passant, na pawn kukuza.
game-0001.name: Chess ya Chess
variationNotes: Fomu ya Ancestral; tembo badala ya maaskofu; baadhi ya akaunti za mapema zinataja dice.
Lugha ya Kiarabu ni yenye mvuto mkubwa na mistari yake huwa mifupi.
Thai chess binamu na nguvu mbalimbali kipande na sheria kukuza.
Chess ya Burma na kuanzisha bure nyuma ya pawns.

game-0002.description: Go ni mchezo wa mzunguko wa eneo. Stones kamwe hoja mara moja kuwekwa; makundi kukamatwa ni kuondolewa. Moja ya sanaa nne za msomi wa Kichina, ilienea Korea (baduk) na Japan (igo). Kucheza usawa encodes, ushawishi, na sura ya kuishi badala ya kukamata moja kwa moja ya mfalme.
howToPlay: Black places the first stone on a grid intersection.
Players alternate placing one stone; stones do not move after placement.
A group without liberties (empty adjacent intersections) is captured and removed.
Do not recreate the previous full-board position (ko) or play suicidal moves unless they capture.
When both pass, score territory plus captives (rules vary by country); higher score wins.
game-0002.name: (Sauti ya Ibilisi)
variationNotes: Utamaduni wa Kikorea na kanuni sawa za msingi na utamaduni wa kufundisha tofauti.
Kijapani mtaalamu safu na wilaya kufunga mikataba.

game-0003.description: Xiangqi (Kichina chess) inaandaa majenerali, washauri, tembo, farasi, magari, cannons, na askari kwenye bodi iliyowekwa ilivuka mto. Ukamataji wa kuruka kwa cannon na kizuizi cha ikulu huipa ladha ya tactical tofauti na chess ya kimataifa. Bado ni bustani na mchezo wa mitaani nchini China.
howToPlay: Panga vipande kwenye maeneo ya kuanzia upande wa pili wa mto.
Red hatua ya kwanza; vipande kwenda pointi kulingana na aina yao.
Cannons slide kama magari lakini kukamata tu kwa kuruka juu ya screen moja.
Wakuu kukaa katika ikulu; kupinga majenerali inaweza si uso juu ya faili wazi.
Kukamata au kuzuia mkuu wa upinzani kushinda.
requirements: Ukumbi wa Xiangqi ukiwa na mto na majumba
game-0003.name: Xiangqiang
variationNotes: Korea binamu bila mto na tofauti tembo / farasi hatua.

game-0004.description: Shogi ni Chess ya Kijapani inayojulikana na matone: vipande vilivyochukuliwa kurudi kama yako mwenyewe. Ni vigumu sana kwa upande wa wapinzani. Vifaa swings na midgame mnene kufafanua mchezo wake; shogi kitaaluma bado kubwa Japan akili mchezo.
howToPlay: Kuweka vipande na mwisho wa pointi kukabiliana na mpinzani.
Hatua ya kwanza - kufuta au kufuta kipande kimoja kwa upande.
Vipande vilivyokamatwa vinakwenda kwenye msimamo wako na vinaweza kutupwa baadaye kwenye viwanja tupu (pamoja na vikwazo vya pawn / kuangalia).
Kuendeleza makundi sahihi katika safu tatu za mwisho.
Angalia mfalme wa upinzani kushinda.
game-0004.name: Shogi ya
variationNotes: Tofauti kubwa ya kihistoria na aina nyingi za kipekee za kipande.

game-0005.description: Mancala ni familia ya michezo ya kupanda: wachezaji kusambaza mbegu kuzunguka mashimo yaliyochongwa katika mbao, mawe, au dunia. Bodi zinaonekana kote Afrika, Mashariki ya Kati, na Asia ya Kusini. Majina ya kikanda na hesabu za shimo hutofautiana, lakini ishara ya scoop-na-sow inaunganisha yao kama mchezo mmoja wa msingi na nyuso nyingi za kitamaduni.
howToPlay: Weka idadi sawa ya mbegu katika kila shimo kwa lahaja yako iliyochaguliwa.
Kisha, safisha nywele zako vizuri, tumia cream ya greasi.
Ukamataji hutokea wakati sowing inaisha katika mipangilio iliyoelezwa na lahaja.
Endelea mpaka upande hauwezi kusonga au mbegu zimechoka kwa sheria za mitaa.
Kuhesabu mbegu katika maduka au mashimo yaliyosalia; jumla ya jumla ya kushinda.
requirements: Bodi yenye safu mbili au zaidi ya mashimo
game-0005.name: Wachezaji wa Mancal Sowing
variationNotes: Akan 2 × 6 classic; kukamata mbegu kinyume wakati mwisho na 2 au 3.
Complex 4-row mchezo wa pwani ya Kiswahili na shimo maalum la nyumba.
Boat-umbo Kusini mwa Asia bodi na maduka makubwa.
Yoruba sowing fomu na rhythmic scooping.
Mtindo wa kisasa wa mafunzo ya biashara ya mancala.

game-0006.description: Mbio-na-hit dice michezo kunyoosha kutoka Royal Game ya Ur kwa Nard Uajemi na meza ya Ulaya. Backgammon inachanganya bahati na ujuzi kama wachezaji hubeba checkers kumi na tano wakati wa kupiga. Mgahawa wa kisasa ni safu ya kimkakati ya kisasa.
howToPlay: Weka checkers katika malezi ya kawaida ya ufunguzi kwenye pointi 24.
Roll dice mbili na kusonga mbele kwa kutumia namba zote mbili.
Piga lone ya kupinga kwenye bar; inapaswa kuingia tena kabla ya hatua nyingine.
Weka hundi yako mwenyewe kwa usalama; pointi sita mfululizo kuunda mkuu.
Wakati wote 15 ni nyumbani, kubeba mbali; kwanza kubeba mbali kushinda wote.
game-0006.name: Nyuma ya nyuma
variationNotes: Mchezo wa meza ya Uajemi karibu na backgammon.
Sehemu ya Kigiriki: Portes, Plakoto, Fevga.
Jina la utamaduni wa café kwa kucheza kama backgammon.
Mzee wa mbio za farasi akiwa na njia ya pekee.

game-0007.description: Senet inaonekana katika uchoraji wa kaburi na bidhaa za mazishi katika Misri ya pharaonic. Ilikuwa na maana ya kidini kama kifungu kupitia maisha ya baadaye. Sheria halisi zinajengwa upya na wataalamu wa Misri kutoka maandiko ya baadaye na geometry ya bodi.
howToPlay: Weka pawns kwenye viwanja vya ufunguzi wa wimbo wa mraba wa 30.
Weka mbegu au mbegu za nyanya kwa muda mrefu.
Kuendeleza njia ya nyoka; makini viwanja maalum (salama, maji, kuzaliwa upya).
Kutatua kutua kwa wapinzani kwa ujenzi unaofuata.
Kwanza kuchukua pawns zote kutoka mraba wa mwisho kushinda.
game-0007.name: Senet

game-0008.description: Patolli ilikuwa mchezo mtakatifu wa mashindano ya Aztec kwenye wimbo wa X-umbo kwa kutumia maharagwe kama dice. Kamari na sadaka za ibada zinaingiliana; mchezo unaonekana katika codices na akaunti za Kihispania kama hatari ya cosmic iliyofanywa kucheza.
howToPlay: Weka bodi ya umbo la X na alama za mahali mwanzoni.
Weka mbolea za kikaboni kwa thamani ya hatua.
Kuendeleza njia ya kufuatilia; kuheshimu nafasi maalum na sheria za kukamata.
Chaguzi za kihistoria zinaweza kubadilishwa na pointi leo.
Kwanza kukamilisha mzunguko na alama zote kushinda.
game-0008.name: Pato la Taifa
variationNotes: Uhusiano wa mbio za Mesoamerican / dice.

game-0009.description: Pachisi - "mchezo wa kitaifa wa India" - ni mashindano ya kuvuka na kuzunguka jadi alicheza na ng'ombe. Chaupar ni uhusiano wa kisheria. Ludo ya Uingereza na Parcheesi ya Amerika ni kizazi cha kibiashara cha jamii hiyo ya msingi.
howToPlay: Kila mchezaji anakaa katika mkono wa msalaba na vipande vinne katika kiota.
Weka sufuria au chemsha chini ya joto mpaka nyanya ziwe tayari.
Nenda karibu na barabara; viwanja salama vinalinda stacks.
Kwa upande mwingine, mshambuliaji wa kati aliwarudisha nyumbani.
Kwanza, kuleta vipande vyote vinne kwenye kituo cha kushinda.
game-0009.name: Mkataba wa
variationNotes: Kuingiliana na mikono na miguu kwa muda mrefu.
Uingereza patented simplification na cubic dice.
Timu ya taifa ya Ujerumani katika mchezo huo.

game-0010.description: Mahjong huchota kadi ya awali ya Kichina na mila ya kamari. Wachezaji wanne wanajenga milds kuelekea mkono kamili wakati wa kusoma. Miundo ya kikanda hutofautiana katika kufunga, lakini "ukuta" wa shuffling ni ukumbi wa kitamaduni wa pamoja.
howToPlay: na cherehani nne peke yake, tayari watu wanne wanakuwa wamepata ajira na
Kuweka mikono (kwa kawaida 13 tiles; muuzaji 14). Mashariki ya Kati kwanza.
tia au chemsha chini ya joto; chemsha chini ya joto.
Fomu chows, pungs, kongs, na jozi.
tangaza mahjong kwa mkono kamili; alama kwa sheria za kikanda.
game-0010.name: Mahjong
variationNotes: Kwa upande wake Mbunge wa Jimbo la Ludewa, Dk.
NMJL kadi ya mikono na jokers.

game-0011.description: Dominoes za Kichina zinahusiana na jozi za uso wa dice; seti mbili za Ulaya zinaenea kupitia Italia na Ufaransa. Kuzuia, kufunga, na michezo ya treni wote kushiriki pip mwisho-kitu kimoja, tamaduni nyingi meza.
howToPlay: Weka mikono katika mchanganyiko na uacha ladha.
Kuongoza kwa tile mbili au juu kwa lahaja.
Kucheza tile vinavyolingana na mwisho wazi, au kuteka / kupita kama huwezi.
Kuzidisha mara mbili katika aina nyingi.
Kushinda kwa kufuta mkono wako au kufikia alama ya pip.
game-0011.name: Dominoes
variationNotes: Double-twelve chama mchezo na treni binafsi.
Kanuni za kawaida za kuzuia / kuondoa.

game-0012.description: Mills michezo kuunda tatu katika-a-row kukamata. Bodi ni kukatwa katika benchi cloister katika Ulaya medieval. Morabarabaraba ya Kusini mwa Afrika ni mashindano sawa ya msingi ya mills na sitiari za kichungaji za 'cow'-zilizojadiliwa hapa kama tofauti, sio uvumbuzi tofauti.
howToPlay: Weka vipande tofauti kwenye pointi tupu mpaka wote tisa ni chini.
Nenda kwenye mistari ya karibu na pointi za karibu.
Unda kinu (tatu katika mstari) ili kuondoa kipande cha kupinga sio katika kinu ikiwa inawezekana.
Wakati chini ya vipande vitatu, kuruka kuruka kwa hatua yoyote tupu ni mara nyingi kuruhusiwa.
Kushinda kwa kupunguza mpinzani kwa vipande viwili au kuzuia hatua zote.
game-0012.name: 9 Maisha ya Morris
variationNotes: Maziwa ya Kusini mwa Afrika na ng'ombe 12 kwa upande; fomu ya michezo ya shule.
Jina la Kizulu kwa mchezo wa mills sawa.
Tofauti kubwa ya ukubwa wa mills.

game-0013.description: Ukamataji wa Alquerque kwenye ubao uliounganishwa umeandikwa katika Kitabu cha Michezo cha Alfonso X. Wachunguzi wa Ulaya / wachunguzi walihamisha wazo hilo kwenye bodi iliyokaguliwa. Sahara kharbaga na kuhusiana Maghreb michezo ni ya moja leap-capture familia-variations ya geometry moja uwindaji.
howToPlay: Kusimama kwa upande wa upinzani.
Nenda kwenye hatua tupu karibu na mstari (au mraba giza katika checkers).
Weka adui wa karibu katika mraba wa kutua tupu ili kukamata.
Endelea kutumia dawa mbalimbali ikiwa inaruhusiwa.
Kukamata maadui wote au immobilize yao kushinda.
requirements: Bodi ya Alquerque au bodi ya uchunguzi
game-0013.name: Familia ya Alquerque / binti
variationNotes: Mkoa wa Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara.

game-0014.description: Fanorona ni mchezo wa bodi ya taifa ya Madagascar wa mbinu na uondoaji. Cascading line kukamata kujenga mbinu kali. Historia ya Oral inaunganisha bodi za siasa za kifalme na ushindani wa jamii.
howToPlay: Fill the board except the center; white moves first.
Weka kipande kimoja kwenye sehemu ya karibu tupu kwenye mstari.
Kukamatwa kwa njia au uondoaji kuhusiana na kundi la adui.
Endelea kukamata na kipande hicho hicho wakati kuna kukamata zaidi.
Kukamata vipande vyote vya kupinga ili kushinda.
game-0014.name: Fantasia ya

game-0015.description: Carrom ni mchezo tabletop kuvutia mpenzi katika Asia ya Kusini na diaspora. Wachezaji flick mshambuliaji mfukoni carrom wanaume, na malkia wanaohitaji cover. Inaunganisha geometry ya billiards na sociability ya chumba cha kukaa.
howToPlay: Powder the board lightly; place pieces in the center with the queen in the middle.
Flick the striker from your base line to hit your color into pockets.
Pocket the queen, then cover it by pocketing one of your pieces immediately after.
Fouls return pieces or cost turns per rule set.
Clear your pieces (with queen covered) to win.
game-0015.name: Carrom
variationNotes: Home » Unlabelled » Sheria za Nyumba za Mitaa na Sheria za Nyumba kwenye Bodi hiyo.

game-0016.description: Kucheza kadi inawezekana alishuka kutoka mawazo ya kadi ya fedha ya Kichina na kuingia Ulaya kupitia staha Mamluk. Kifaransa suti akawa chombo kimataifa standard kwa maelfu ya michezo. Kanda decks ni tofauti ya jukwaa moja portable michezo ya kubahatisha - si kabisa tofauti toys.
howToPlay: Use a 52-card French-suited deck; shuffle, then deal thirteen cards to each of four players for a Hearts-style starter game.
Play proceeds clockwise; lead any suit except hearts until hearts are broken; players must follow suit if able.
Highest card of the led suit wins the trick; hearts score 1 penalty point each and the queen of spades scores 13.
After all thirteen tricks, tally penalty points; rotate the dealer clockwise for the next hand.
Play hands until one player reaches 100 penalty points; the lowest score wins (or switch later to whist, rummy, or another named game).
requirements: Kadi ya Kifaransa ya 52 (au staha ya kikanda)
game-0016.name: Kucheza kadi (Kifaransa-suited Deck)
variationNotes: 40- au 48-kadi za kadi kwa ajili ya mus, tute, nk.

game-0017.description: Utamaduni wa karuta wa Kijapani ni pamoja na hanafuda ya msimu na uta-garuta ya fasihi. Kofia ya shairi-karuta inahitaji utambuzi wa umeme; hanafuda underpins koi-koi. Kadi huunganisha misimu, mashairi, na kasi katika familia moja ya vitu vya kucheza.
howToPlay: Kwa uta-garuta: msomaji anapiga nusu ya kwanza ya shairi.
Wachezaji mbio kwa kupiga kadi matching mwisho.
Chukua kadi na uendelee kupitia seti.
Kwa ajili ya hanafuda/koi-koi: mpango, kukamata kwa vinavyolingana miezi, na kutangaza yaku.
Ni aina gani ya karuta familia wewe ni kucheza kabla ya kushughulika.
game-0017.name: Hanafuda / Karuta
variationNotes: Moja ya michezo ya kadi ya zawadi.

game-0018.description: Ganjifa ni kadi za mviringo zilizochorwa na mahakama za Mughal na za kikanda za India, baadaye hutengenezwa na watu katika maeneo kama vile Odisha. Mifumo ya suti (Mughal, Dashavatara) hutofautiana, lakini taratibu za kuchukua hila zinaunganisha kama utamaduni mmoja wa kadi ya rangi.
howToPlay: Use an 8-suit Mughal ganjifa set (96 circular cards) or a 10-suit Dashavatara set; shuffle gently without bending paint layers.
For a four-player Mughal session, deal twelve cards each; decide trump by the first suit led or a declared trump suit before play.
Players must follow the led suit if able; otherwise they may play trump or discard.
Highest trump wins the trick if any trump is played; otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins.
Each won trick scores one point (or count face cards if using a court-heavy house tally); highest trick total after all cards are played wins. Store cards flat.
requirements: Jinsi ya kuchagua rangi ya rangi
game-0018.name: Ganjifa

game-0019.description: Kondoo au mbuzi mifupa astragalus walikuwa dice ya kale kwa ajili ya kucheza na uganga. Watoto walianguka na kuwachukua; watu wazima waliketi kwenye nyuso. Jacks ya kisasa ni kizazi cha ujuzi wa utamaduni huo wa pickup.
howToPlay: Start with five astragali (or five jacks plus a small bounce ball if using modern replicas).
Scatter the pieces, toss one aloft (or bounce the ball once), and pick up one piece before catching the tossed piece or ball.
On later turns in the same round, pick up two, then three, then four pieces in one sweep while the toss or bounce is airborne.
Failing to catch or disturbing the remaining pile ends your turn; the next player restarts at picking up ones.
First player to complete the ones–twos–threes–fours sequence scores one point; play to five points. Use plastic or wooden replicas when real bones are unavailable.
requirements: Maji ya chini au ya juu
game-0019.name: Kikoa cha kiwango cha juu
variationNotes: Metal /plastic jacks na mpira wa kikapu.

game-0020.description: Disk-on-string toys kuonekana katika sanaa ya kale; kisasa yo-yo boom alisafiri kwa njia ya wazalishaji Filipino na bidhaa za Marekani. Kulala, kufunga, na hila za kamba hugeuka rotor rahisi katika msamiati wa ujuzi. Ushindani huhukumu ugumu na mtindo.
howToPlay: Weka mikono katika mchanganyiko kwa robo ya saa.
Weka chini kwa kiasi kikubwa, ili uweze kulala chini.
Jaribu kurudi, au kufanya hila wakati wa kulala.
Kujifunza usingizi, kupita mbele, na mwamba-mtoto kama misingi.
Kushindana na orodha ya hila au usingizi wa uvumilivu.
game-0020.name: ya ya ya

game-0021.description: Kites inaweza kuanza nchini China kwa ishara na sherehe kabla ya kuwa michezo ya watoto duniani kote. Tamaduni za wapiganaji katika Afghanistan, India, Brazil na Japan zinaongeza mistari ya kukata na mapigano ya angani. Toy hujiunga na ufundi, kusoma hali ya hewa, na tamasha la umma.
howToPlay: Funga mlango na uacha ladha.
Na nyuma ya upepo, kuwa na msaada kushikilia au uzinduzi kama wewe reel mvutano.
Steer with line angle; climb in steady wind.
Katika tofauti za mpiganaji, jaribu kupunguza mstari wa mpinzani.
Kupumua kabla ya dhoruba; kamwe kuruka karibu na mistari ya nguvu.
requirements: Fungua nafasi ya upepo mbali na mistari ya nguvu
game-0021.name: Ndege ya kuruka
variationNotes: Manja abrasive line kwa vita vya kite.
kubwa ya kijamii na kupambana na matukio.

game-0022.description: Utoto wa Cat na takwimu zinazohusiana na kamba zinaonekana kutoka Arctic hadi Oceania na kufanana kwa kuanza. Takwimu hupita kati ya mikono katika mlolongo, mafunzo ya kumbukumbu ya anga na ushirikiano. Wanaanthropolojia walirekodi mamia ya mifumo inayoitwa imefungwa na hadithi.
howToPlay: Loop a 1–2 meter cord; Player A opens Cat’s Cradle: palms facing, strings across both hands with the palmar string crossed once.
Player B pinches the two crossed X’s, pulls them out and down, then up through the center, taking the figure onto their own hands as Soldier’s Bed (or Mattress).
Player A next takes the side strings to form Candles, then Player B takes again to form the Manger (or Cradle reverse).
If any loop slips off a finger and the figure collapses, both players restart from Player A’s opening cradle.
After one clean four-step pass (Cradle → Bed → Candles → Manger), try the sequence again or learn a solo figure such as Cup and Saucer.
game-0022.name: Mto wa Cat
variationNotes: Soma hadithi kwa majina ya mitaa na maelezo.

game-0023.description: Jianzi anaendelea kutembea kwa miguu na miguu - michezo ya Hifadhi inayopatikana nchini China na jamii za nje. Mzunguko wa kucheza hujenga rhythm; kucheza solo hujenga kumbukumbu za hesabu. Kikorea jegichagi na Kivietinamu đá cuu ni sawa msingi mguu-shuttlecock mchezo.
howToPlay: Weka kamba kwenye miguu yako.
Kick na mguu wa ndani, mguu wa nje, au goti ili kuiweka hewani.
Kuhesabu kicks mfululizo; kuanza juu ya kushuka.
Katika mzunguko, kwenda kwa majirani bila kutumia mikono.
Kukubaliana kama kuokoa mkono ni kuruhusiwa (kawaida si).
game-0023.name: Jianzi (shuttlecock kicking)
variationNotes: Meli ya kubeba mizigo ya Korea.

game-0024.description: Sepak takraw inachanganya kucheza kwa wavu wa voliboli kama kucheza kwa miguu, magoti, kifua, na anwani za kichwa tu. Mizizi iko katika kick ya ulimwengu wa Malay (sepak raga). Superhead baiskeli kicks kufafanua tamasha ya kisasa.
howToPlay: Mark a court about 13.4 × 6.1 m with a net 1.52 m high (men’s sport height) and use a rattan or synthetic takraw ball.
Each team of three stands on its side; the server’s teammate tosses the ball for a foot serve over the net into the opponent’s court.
A side may use at most three touches with foot, knee, chest, or head before sending the ball back; hands and arms are faults.
Score one point when the ball grounds in the opponent’s court or the opponent faults (net touch with hand, four touches, out of bounds).
Play to 21 points per set (must win by 2); best of three sets decides the match.
requirements: Net na mahakama kwa fomu ya michezo
game-0024.name: ya takraw
variationNotes: Hifadhi ya Hifadhi ya Hifadhi ya Jamii bila ya Mtandao.

game-0025.description: Stickball kati ya mataifa ya asili ya kaskazini-mashariki yalikuwa na uzito wa kiroho na kidiplomasia-mchezo wa Muumba. Wafuatiliaji wa Kifaransa walimtaja Lacrosse. codes kisasa rasmi michezo sheria, lakini cradling na kufunga na fimbo netted kuendelea utamaduni kina.
howToPlay: timu mbili na kuweka malengo.
Nenda kwenye kituo.
Kubeba, kupita, na risasi kwa kutumia mfukoni fimbo (hakuna mkono juu ya mpira katika sheria uwanja).
Kuweka alama kwa kutuma mpira katika lengo.
Kiwango cha juu zaidi katika ushindi wa mwisho.
game-0025.name: Lacrosse ya
variationNotes: Double-stick mpira michezo na mazingira tofauti mila.

game-0026.description: Mchezo wa mpira wa Mesoamerican ulitumia mipira nzito ya mpira iliyopigwa hasa na hips kwenye mahakama rasmi. Ritual, siasa, na michezo iliingiliana. Ulama ya kisasa katika Sinaloa inaendelea kucheza kama uzao wa kuishi.
howToPlay: Play ulama de cadera on a long packed-earth alley about 65 m; two teams of three to five wear hip pads and use a solid rubber ball.
Serve by bouncing the ball to a teammate who strikes it forward with the hip only—no hands, feet, or heads.
Teams volley the ball back and forth across the midline; a bounce must stay within the alley sidelines.
Score one point when the opposing team fails to return, lets the ball stop, or sends it out of the alley.
First team to 8 points wins the game (common Sinaloa street tally); rest and switch ends after each game.
game-0026.name: Mchezo wa Mpira wa Mesoamerican / Ulama

game-0027.description: Kokeshi ni dolls za mbao zilizogeuka kutoka miji ya Honshu onsen-kumbu za kwanza na toys za watoto, sasa zilizokusanywa sanaa. Shule za Mkoa (Naruko, Tsuchiyu, na wengine) hutofautiana katika viungo vya kichwa na uchoraji wa floral.
howToPlay: Kushikilia au kushikilia doll; hakuna bao la ushindani.
Watoto wanaweza kutunga hadithi za kulea karibu na kokeshi.
Wakusanyaji hulinganisha shule, saini, na uwiano.
Kumwagilia maua kwa upole.
Tumia kama chombo cha ufundi wa utamaduni na karibu kucheza.
game-0027.idealParticipants: Home / Burudani / Nay wa Mitego / Nay wa Mitego
game-0027.name: Kiko
variationNotes: Bonyeza kichwa cha shule ya pamoja.

game-0028.description: Matryoshka viota dolls walikuwa kuundwa katika 1890s katika warsha Abramutsevo, kusukumwa na fomu nesting na wakulima mavazi motifs. Kila ufunguzi unafunua dada mdogo - kuimarisha mwendelezo wa familia na uzazi - na kuwa icon ya hila ya kimataifa.
howToPlay: Fungua doll kubwa zaidi katika bahari.
Weka juu ya kila doll ya ndani kwa ukubwa.
Waachwe wazuiwe mara moja.
Kuleta kuhesabu au hadithi ya michezo kwa watoto.
Usiwe na nguvu za kutosha.
game-0028.name: Matryoshka

game-0029.description: dolls ya wasiwasi wa Guatemala ni takwimu ndogo ambazo watoto wanasema shida kabla ya kuwaweka chini ya mto. Folklore anasema dolls kubeba wasiwasi usiku - ibada ya sauti na faraja zaidi kuliko kucheza ushindani.
howToPlay: Ondoa wasiwasi mmoja kwa kila doll.
Kumwagilia maua katika chafu au katika chumba cha kulala usiku.
Asubuhi hii nawashukuru na kuwakumbukeni daima.
Tumia dolls nyingi kama wasiwasi (hasa wachache).
Hakuna dhamana - ibada ya faraja ya kibinafsi.
game-0029.name: Kuwa na dolls

game-0030.description: Vipodozi vya nguruwe ni jadi kati ya mataifa kadhaa ya asili na baadaye wakazi wa vijijini. Uso mara nyingi huachwa tupu, na mafundisho maalum ya jamii kuhusu kwa nini. Kufanya mazoezi ni nusu ya mchezo.
howToPlay: Soak husks; fold and tie a head, arms, and body or skirt.
Air-Dry kumaliza doll.
Kucheza michezo ya kubahatisha au kuonyesha takwimu.
Fuata itifaki za jamii wakati wa kujifunza ndani ya utamaduni wa kuishi.
Weka dolls kavu ili kuzuia mold.
game-0030.name: Kikoa cha kiwango cha juu

game-0031.description: toys kombe-na-balaji changamoto mkono-macho wakati: swing mpira tethered katika kikombe au kwenye spike. Kifaransa bilboquet, Mexican balero, na Kijapani kendama ni tofauti ya familia moja ujuzi na vocabularies tofauti ya tricks.
howToPlay: Hold the handle with the ball hanging on its cord.
Swing juu na kukamata mpira katika kikombe au juu ya spike.
Kuendeleza flips na majina ya hila.
Ufuatiliaji wa upatikanaji wa samaki.
Fanya mazoezi kwenye eneo lenye utulivu wakati wa kujifunza.
requirements: mpira wa miguu au mpira wa miguu.
game-0031.name: Bilboquet / Balero / familia ya Kendama
variationNotes: Utamaduni wa mpira wa miguu wa Mexico.
Multi-cup spike toy na hila kubwa ya lexicon.
Kombe la Ulaya na mpira wa miguu.

game-0032.description: Tangram hugawanya mraba katika tans saba zinazotumiwa kuunda silhouettes. Ilienea kutoka China kama craze ya parlor katika karne ya 19. Mabadiliko ya Geometric na nafasi mbaya ni masomo ya utulivu ya toy.
howToPlay: Kuanza na vipande vyote saba kutengeneza mraba.
Kupata kadi ya silhouette changamoto.
Tumia vipande vyote saba ili kulinganisha muhtasari bila kuingiliana.
Kujenga wanyama wa bure au barua.
majaribio ya muda kwa ajili ya ushindani.
game-0032.name: Tangram ya

game-0033.description: Ernő Rubik ya cubes maarufu puzzles ya mchanganyiko wa pande tatu duniani kote. Layer-turn mechanics kujificha nadharia ya kikundi ndani ya toy rangi. Speedcubing utamaduni aliongeza algorithms, vifaa, na muda wa michezo-bado moja puzzle katika moyo.
howToPlay: Kugeuza nyuso kwa njia ya ajabu.
Kurejesha kila uso kwa rangi imara kwa kutumia mbinu za safu au intuition.
Kompyuta mara nyingi kutatua msalaba nyeupe, kisha pembe, makali ya katikati, na safu ya mwisho.
Wafanyabiashara wa juu hukariri algorithms kwa kasi.
Chaguo: Muda wa kutatua na stackmat au timer ya simu.
game-0033.name: Ukumbi wa Rubik
variationNotes: Kiwango cha juu cha cuboid na mbinu za kupunguza.

game-0034.description: Vizuwizi vya Stacking ni kati ya vinyago vya zamani vya ujenzi - mawe, udongo, na miti ya kuni huonekana katika ustaarabu. Froebel zawadi rasmi ya kuzuia elimu kucheza katika karne ya 19. Hatua ya msingi ni kukusanya fomu kutoka kwa solids za kawaida.
howToPlay: Ni wazi kuwa kuna jengo la kisasa.
Stack, daraja, na cantilever vitalu katika minara au nyumba.
Kukubaliana changamoto za hiari (jengo la juu kabisa, urefu wa daraja, nakala ya mfano).
Kucheza kama sehemu ya kucheza kama unataka.
Kuvaa nguo wakati wa kuondoka.
game-0034.name: Ujenzi wa vitalu
variationNotes: Mfumo wa elimu kwa watoto wa chekechea.
Shule ya msingi ya Caroline Pratt.

game-0035.description: Chunkey alikuwa mchezo wa plaza wa Mississippi: diski ya jiwe iliyopigwa na mikuki ili kutabiri kuanguka kwake. Hali, kamari, na athleticism alikutana karibu mounds. Archaeology inarudi vizuri mawe ya chunkey katika Midwest na Kusini.
howToPlay: Mchezaji mmoja anapiga jiwe la chunkey kwenye ardhi.
Wengine hutupa pole kuelekea mahali ambapo jiwe litasimama.
Weka alama kwa karibu wakati mawe yanapumzika.
majukumu ya Rotate; kucheza kwa jumla ya pointi walikubaliana.
Weka watazamaji wazi njia ya kutupa.
game-0035.name: Chunkey ya

game-0036.description: Palín (chueca) ni mchezo wa fimbo na mpira wa miguu na umuhimu wa jumuiya na mila. Timu zinaendesha mpira kuelekea malengo kwa muda mrefu. Bado ni alama ya mkusanyiko wa Mapuche na utambulisho.
howToPlay: Weka malengo ya muda mrefu katika kila mwisho.
Kuanza mpira katikati ya timu.
Piga kwa fimbo kuelekea lengo lako-hakuna swings hatari kwa watu.
Weka alama wakati mpira unavuka nafasi ya lengo.
Kucheza pointi walikubaliana; heshima ufunguzi sherehe wakati mwenyeji jadi.
game-0036.name: Kwa bahati mbaya

game-0037.description: Vita inaonekana katika rites ya mavuno, michezo ya shule, na sherehe za kijiji duniani kote. Baadhi ya aina za Asia ya Mashariki na Pasifiki hubeba maana ya cosmological ya usawa wa msimu. Timu mbili, kamba moja - mashindano ya uratibu wa msingi.
howToPlay: Weka mstari wa katikati na mistari ya timu.
Timu zinashika kwa usawa; epuka kufunga kamba karibu na miguu katika sheria za michezo.
Kwa ishara, kuvuta na heaves short uratibu.
Kushinda kwa kuunganisha alama ya kituo kwenye mstari wako.
Acha mara moja ikiwa mtu anaanguka kwa hatari.
game-0037.name: Vita vya vita
variationNotes: Kuweka alama katika matukio ya kalenda ya ibada.

game-0038.description: Hide-na-kutafuta ni mchezo wa watoto wa karibu wa chuo kikuu na majina isitoshe ya ndani na kuhesabu rhymes. Inarudia kuiba, kumbukumbu ya anga, na furaha ya kijamii ya kupatikana. Usanifu-kutoka kasbah alleys hadi ghorofa stairwells-reshapes mkakati.
howToPlay: Pick one seeker and a home base (tree, wall, or stoop); set hard bounds—no street, no locked rooms.
The seeker faces the base and counts aloud to 50 while others hide inside the bounds.
The seeker shouts “Ready or not, here I come,” then tags hiders by touch; tagged players walk to a jail spot beside home base.
A free hider may dash to base, touch it, and call “Free [name]!” to release one jailed player; if the seeker tags them on the way, they go to jail.
When all hiders are jailed, or after five minutes, the first player tagged becomes the next seeker.
game-0038.name: Hide-and-seek
variationNotes: Kwa upande mwingine, kwa upande mwingine, kuna njia nyingine, kwa upande mwingine, kwa upande mwingine.

game-0039.description: grids Hopping kwa alama kurushwa kuonekana katika mabara na maumbo ya ndani na rhymes. Mizani, kugeuka-kuchukua, na pavement chalk sanaa kukutana katika mbio moja rahisi kupitia seli kuhesabiwa.
howToPlay: Inaunganisha gridi ya taifa ya hopscotch.
Piga alama kwenye mraba wa pili; lazima iwe safi ndani.
Kuruka kwa mguu mmoja, kuruka uwanja ulichukua.
Weka alama ya kurudi bila makosa.
Awali ya yote, idadi ya kushinda.
requirements: Chalk au scratched gridi ya taifa
game-0039.name: Kocha
variationNotes: Kihispania-lugha hopscotch naming na rangi ya gridi.
Kifaransa hopscotch gridi na sheria ya shule.

game-0040.description: Mpira wa marumaru ni karibu michezo ya watoto wote. Clay, jiwe, na baadaye nyanja kioo ni knuckle-shot kwa knock malengo kutoka mduara. ‘Keepsies’ dhidi ya marafiki kuamua kama washindi kuweka marumaru kukamata.
howToPlay: Kusanya mduara na mahali marumaru lengo ndani.
Knuckle-shoot kutoka makali kwa knock malengo nje.
Alama ya marumaru iliyopatikana au imehifadhiwa kulingana na vigingi vilivyokubaliwa.
Kama shooter yako bado katika-ring, sheria nyingi kuruhusu risasi nyingine kutoka huko.
Bonyeza kitufe au kufikia lengo la kushinda.
requirements: Glass, clay, au jiwe jiwe marbles
game-0040.name: Marbles ya

game-0041.description: Tops ni miongoni mwa toys kongwe ya binadamu mitambo, excavated kutoka Ur kwa Indus na zaidi. Mstari-kuzindua na whip-sustained fomu msaada ushindani uvumilivu na kupambana. Majina ya mitaa tofauti; masomo ya fizikia ni pamoja.
howToPlay: Upepo huzunguka kwenye mwili au kuandaa whip.
Kuanza na kuvuta laini hivyo ncha spins juu ya ardhi ngumu.
Tumia nguvu ya ziada ili kuongeza nishati.
Kushindana kwa ajili ya spin mrefu au kwa kugonga nje wapinzani.
Kusafisha nywele kama inahitajika.
requirements: mbao, udongo au chuma cha juu
game-0041.name: Juu ya kichwa
variationNotes: Mapambano ya Cord-thrown na tops ya hila.
Mavazi ya Kijapani na mavazi ya juu.
Asia ya Kusini hufunga / kufunga kamba.

game-0042.description: Hnefatafl ni uwindaji wa Norse asymmetric: mfalme na watetezi wanajaribu kutoroka washambuliaji kwenye gridi ya taifa. Aina mbalimbali za wadudu huenea katika ulimwengu wa Viking. Uwiano wa vikosi na viwanja vya kiti cha enzi hufafanua mwisho wa nyakati.
howToPlay: Play Copenhagen Hnefatafl on an 11×11 board: place the king on the center throne with 12 defenders in a cross; place 24 attackers in the four edge camps.
Attackers move first. Every piece slides any number of empty squares like a rook; none may jump.
Capture an enemy by sandwiching it between two of your pieces on a rank or file (custodial capture); the throne and corner squares can help bracket.
Attackers win by capturing the king on two opposite sides (or against the throne/edge as a second side). Defenders win if the king reaches any of the four corner sanctuary squares.
Pieces may not stop on the throne except the king; attackers may not occupy the corners.
requirements: Mfalme na watetezi dhidi ya washambuliaji
game-0042.name: Hnefatafl
variationNotes: Linnaeus alirekodi jina la Sámi tablut – familia moja ya tafl.
Kwa upande wake Balozi wa Ireland katika Baraza la Mawaziri Mhe.

game-0043.description: kuwinda asymmetric juu ya msalaba: geese kujaribu kona mbweha kwamba leaps kukamata. Kuhusiana na bodi nyingi za prey duniani kote - fomu ya parlor ya Ulaya imeorodheshwa hapa na binamu kama tofauti.
howToPlay: Weka geese kwenye mwisho mmoja na mbweha katikati au kinyume kwa sheria.
Hatua ya kwanza au ya pili kwa makubaliano; hutembea bila kuruka.
Fox inaweza kuruka karibu geese kukamata.
Geese kushinda kwa immobilizing mbweha; mbweha kushinda kwa kukamata geese ya kutosha.
Tumia bodi ya kisasa ya mbweha nageese ikiwa bodi za kihistoria hazipatikani.
game-0043.name: Fox na Gees

game-0044.description: Five-in-a-row kwenye gridi ya Go-kama ni pastime ya kale ya Asia ya Mashariki iliyo rasmi kama gomoku na renju. Kutenganisha kutoka kwa eneo la Go - lengo ni tano moja kwa moja.
howToPlay: Maeneo ya Black kwanza kwenye makutano.
Wachezaji kubadilisha kuweka jiwe moja.
Kwanza kuunda mawe tano mfululizo katika mstari kushinda.
Renju ya michezo inaongeza vikwazo vya kufungua kwa usawa.
Kucheza kwenye bodi ya gomoku au bodi ya Go.
game-0044.name: Gomoku au Gomoku
variationNotes: Kiwango cha ushindani wa ushindani kwa 5-in-a-row.

game-0045.description: Reversi flips sandwiched discs kudai wengi rangi. Othello kawaida branding na kufungua. Mashindano safi ya uwekaji-na-flip na swings ya kulipuka.
howToPlay: Weka diski nne katikati katika ufunguzi wa Othello wa kawaida.
Black maeneo kwanza kwenye mraba kwamba flips angalau moja nyeupe disc.
Kuruka kila aina ya sandwiched wapinzani discs katika kila upande.
Mchezaji hawezi flip hupita; wakati wote wawili hawawezi kusonga, kuhesabu diski.
Sehemu kubwa ya ushindi.
game-0045.name: Uhariri / Othello
variationNotes: Biashara ya kisasa standardization ya kucheza reversi-kama.

game-0046.description: Scrabble inapeana maadili ya uhakika kwa barua kwenye gridi ya mtindo wa crossword na viwanja vya premium. Alizaliwa kutoka utamaduni wa crossword wa Marekani, ikawa mchezo wa neno la kimataifa na seti maalum za lugha.
howToPlay: Weka vigae saba; weka neno la kwanza kupitia nyota ya katikati.
Kujenga maneno mapya kuunganisha na barua zilizopo crossword-style.
Alama ya barua thamani nyakati premium; tally kila zamu.
Baada ya kila mchezo, rudia safu saba.
Juu alama wakati tiles kukimbia nje na mchezaji mmoja empties rack yao kushinda.
game-0046.name: Slabble

game-0047.description: Paramapada sopanam / gyan chaupar alifundisha karma na fadhila kama ngazi na makamu kama nyoka. Nyoka wa Uingereza na Ladders walitawala mbio za watoto - sawa na msingi wa maadili ya juu na chini.
howToPlay: Bonyeza kitufe cha kuingia; Bonyeza kitufe cha kuingia.
Kuendeleza mwelekeo wa kifo.
Ardhi katika ngazi ya ngazi ya kupanda; ardhi juu ya kichwa nyoka na slide chini.
Kuna haja ya kuwa na akiba ya kutosha.
Kwanza kwa ushindi wa mwisho.
requirements: Bodi ya gridi na nyoka na ngazi
game-0047.name: Nyoka na ngazi
variationNotes: Mzee wa Doactic na wema na uovu ulioandikwa.
Milton ya Marekani Bradley akivaa jezi ya timu hiyo.

game-0048.description: Mali-trading mbio michezo kukosoa au kusherehekea halisi ya hali ya ubepari. Mchezo wa Magie's Landlord kabla ya Parker Brothers' Monopoly. Mitaa matoleo ramani miji ya dunia kwenye sawa kununua-rent-bankrupt kitanzi.
howToPlay: Kila mchezaji huanza na fedha zilizotengwa na ishara kwenye Go.
Roll dice, hoja, na kununua mali isiyohamishika wewe ardhi juu ya-au kulipa kodi.
Kujenga nyumba / hoteli kwenye seti kamili ya rangi.
Kusimamia mikopo na biashara.
Mchezaji wa mwisho hakushinda.
game-0048.name: Monopoly

game-0049.description: Kumwagilia ni njia ya zamani ya kuondoa vipande kutoka kwenye stack bila kuanguka. Leslie Scott soko mnara mchezo duniani kote; puzzle kimwili ni moja ya pamoja stack kwa wachezaji wote.
howToPlay: Kujenga mnara katika kubadilisha tabaka crosswise ya tatu.
Kwa upande wako, uondoe block moja chini ya safu ya juu isiyokamilika kwa kutumia mkono mmoja.
Weka kwenye sehemu ya juu ili kukamilisha au kuendelea.
Mchezaji ambaye topples mnara kupoteza (au mchezaji wa kwanza kushinda).
Jaribu tena kucheza.
game-0049.name: Jenga

game-0050.description: Kichina kongzhu / diabolo huzunguka kamba kati ya fimbo-mali, kuongeza kasi, na kujiua hufanya msamiati wa sarakasi. Vyama vya Ulaya vilikubali na kubadili jina la diabolo.
howToPlay: Kuanza spool rocking juu ya kamba.
Kuharakisha na mabadiliko ya fimbo fimbo.
Kuvuta na kukamata; kujaribu mbinu orbit.
Kuhesabu upatikanaji wa mara kwa mara au alama za hila.
Tumia nafasi wazi ya taa na nyuso.
game-0050.name: Diabolo
variationNotes: Jina la Kichina na mila ya watu / crcus kwa toy sawa ya spool.

game-0051.description: Pick-up fimbo (spillikins, jackstraws) kushuka katika tangle; wachezaji dondoo fimbo bila kusonga wengine. Thamani ya rangi. Jaribio la utulivu la udhibiti mzuri wa motor.
howToPlay: Weka mikono katika mchanganyiko kwa robo ya saa.
Wachezaji wengine huvuta fimbo moja bila kuvuta wengine.
Na kama wengine wanakurudisha nyuma.
Kuweka alama kwa rangi / thamani.
Kiwango cha juu wakati rundo linashinda.
game-0051.name: Kapu kuapu / Jackstraws / Spillikins
variationNotes: Jina la biashara ya pick-up imewekwa.

game-0052.description: Mehen, mchezo wa nyoka wa coiled, inaonekana katika Misri ya mapema ya dynastic. Kucheza wakiongozwa pamoja na kupanda nyoka kuelekea katikati; sheria halisi ni vipande, lakini bodi takatifu ya wanyama fomu ni wazi.
howToPlay: Weka vipande kwenye mkia wa nyoka.
Weka mbegu za mbegu za kupanda kwenye mbegu.
Kutatua mwingiliano wakati wa kugawana sehemu kwa ujenzi wa kuchaguliwa.
Njia ya kuingia inaweza kurudi nyuma.
Kwanza kabisa, ni mafanikio ya safari katika maeneo mengi.
game-0052.name: Meno ya

game-0053.description: Cast au printed askari miniature mkono vita kucheza na baadaye vita. Watengenezaji wa bati wa Ujerumani na matangazo ya mashimo ya Uingereza huenea duniani kote. Kucheza safu kutoka vita rahisi line kwa utawala-heavy simulations.
howToPlay: Array two equal forces of at least ten figures each on opposite ends of a table or sand tray; place one flag token behind each line.
On a turn, move up to three of your figures up to one hand-span forward, sideways, or diagonally.
If a figure ends within one finger-width of an enemy, roll one six-sided die: 4–6 removes the enemy; 1–3 misses. Remove casualties to a dead pile.
Capture the opponent’s flag by ending a move on its square, or eliminate every enemy figure, to win.
Store figures upright in a box with tissue so paint and bayonets do not chip.
requirements: Chumba cha kulala au sand table
game-0053.name: Kasri ya Buckingham Palace kwa askari kando: Toy askari
variationNotes: Wanajeshi wa zamani wa Jeshi la Kujenga Taifa.

game-0054.description: Chai ndogo huruhusu watoto kusoma ibada za ukarimu. Matoleo ya Porcelain na bati yalifuatilia tamaduni za chai za watu wazima kutoka Uingereza hadi Japan. Maandishi ya kijamii—wakati, kutoa, kushukuru—ni kanuni halisi.
howToPlay: Kuweka nafasi kwa dolls au marafiki.
Pour (real or imaginary) tea without tipping cups.
Mazoezi ya kutumikia amri na maneno ya heshima.
Ondoa na kuweka kama sehemu ya kucheza.
Hakuna alama - mchezo wa kucheza.
game-0054.name: Vinywaji kwa wakubwa

game-0055.description: Slinky hubadilisha nishati ya uwezo katika ngazi ya mwisho ya kutembea. Ajali ya furaha ya uhandisi wa spring ya majini ilikuwa dawati la kimataifa na stair toy.
howToPlay: Weka kamba kwenye kitambaa cha juu.
Weka kamba ya juu kwenye hatua inayofuata ya chini.
Hebu angalia jinsi ya kushughulika na mite wa buibui.
Katika chumba cha baridi, safisha mikono yako vizuri.
Epuka kupanda mbegu za nyanya kwa muda mrefu.
game-0055.name: Slinky ya

game-0056.description: Flying discs rasmi pwani na Hifadhi kutupa; mwisho na disc golf aliongeza michezo frames. Toy ya msingi ni sahani ya gliding ya mkono.
howToPlay: Weka sahani kwa vidole chini ya rim.
Weka mbegu kwenye mbegu; tengeneza mbegu.
Tumia mikono miwili wakati wa kujifunza.
Kucheza catch, alama ya mwisho, au mashimo disc-golf.
Kuwa na hisia na watazamaji.
game-0056.name: Frisbee / Flying disc

game-0057.description: Kuweka mfuko mdogo aloft na miguu echoes zamani Eurasian kickbag kucheza. Vikao vya "sunny" vinasisitiza mtindo na kugawana juu ya kufunga.
howToPlay: Weka mfuko kwenye mguu na uinue kwa upole.
Tumia miguu, miguu, miguu na miguu - hakuna mikono.
Kwa upande mwingine, kwenda kwa majirani.
Kuhesabu kicks mfululizo.
Kuanza tena baada ya kupanda.
game-0057.name: Kikoa cha chini / footbag
variationNotes: Hadithi za zamani za kuweka kick zinazohusiana na roho.

game-0058.description: Kurejea boomerangs ni usahihi-carved kutupa fimbo kutoka Aboriginal Australia mila, pia kutumika katika fomu za uwindaji ambazo hazirudi. Utalii michezo boomerangs kurahisisha toy kurudi; ujuzi wa utamaduni wa miundo bado na jamii.
howToPlay: Tumia tu katika maeneo makubwa ya wazi bila watu kupungua.
Weka na ubonyeze kwa njia hii.
Basi angalia ulikuwaje mwisho wa mafisadi!
Fanya ardhi ikiwa hauna uhakika.
Jifunze kutoka kwa wauzaji wenye ujuzi; kuheshimu umiliki wa kubuni.
game-0058.name: Boomer ya ya

game-0059.description: Māori poi swung katika rhythm ya ngoma na hadithi. Moto wa kisasa na poi utendaji huongeza toy duniani kote; mazingira ya jadi yanaendelea mazoezi ya kitamaduni.
howToPlay: Weka mipaka ya wazi kwa watu.
Swing katika duru rahisi upande kwa beat.
Ongeza mipangilio kama ujuzi unavyoongezeka.
Katika maonyesho ya utamaduni, kufuata wimbo na choreography.
Tumia poi ya moto tu na mazoezi ya usalama wa kitaaluma.
requirements: Poi (flax au uzito wa kisasa kwenye kamba)
game-0059.name: hoi hoi ya hoi

game-0060.description: Surakarta ni mchezo wa kukamata Javanese ambapo vipande vya kusafiri kuzunguka loops rangi. kukamata kufuata loops badala ya kuruka rahisi- mkakati kifahari kikanda toy.
howToPlay: Bonyeza upande wa kulia wa skrini yako.
Nenda kwenye maeneo ya wazi.
Kukamatwa kwa kusafiri pamoja na kitanzi mzunguko kwenye adui.
Vipande vilivyoondolewa huacha mapungufu ambayo hufungua njia.
Kupata maadui wote kushinda.
game-0060.name: Sura ya

game-0061.description: Dakon ni bodi ya kupanda ya familia ya Javanese congkak, ambayo mara nyingi imechorwa. Ni iliyotolewa kama jina la kikanda standard ndani ya mancala wakati kubaki moja sowing familia.
howToPlay: Use a boat board with seven small cups per side plus one large store (lumbung) at each end; place seven seeds in every small cup.
On your turn, scoop one of your cups and sow one seed clockwise into each following cup, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your store, sow again immediately from any of your cups that still hold seeds (relay turn).
If the last seed lands in an empty cup on your side, capture that seed and all seeds in the opposite cup into your store.
When one player cannot move, remaining seeds go to the owner of those cups; most seeds in store wins.
game-0061.name: Dafuna
variationNotes: Karibu kuhusiana Malay mashua-board sowing mchezo - familia moja.

game-0062.description: Sungka ni Filipino mashua-umbo sowing mchezo, binamu kwa congkak. Bodi ni mrithi wa kaya; kucheza mchanganyiko wa kasi kupanda na muda wa kukamata.
howToPlay: Seat two players at a sungka board with seven small cups (bahay) per side and one head store (ulo) each; place seven cowries or seeds in every bahay.
Scoop all seeds from one of your bahay and sow counterclockwise one-by-one into each following cup, including your ulo but skipping the opponent’s ulo.
If the last seed lands in your ulo, take another turn; if it lands in an empty bahay on your side, capture the opposite bahay’s seeds into your ulo.
A player who empties their side early waits while the opponent may still sow; continue until neither side has seeds left in bahay.
Count cowries in each ulo; the higher store wins.
game-0062.name: Sungka
variationNotes: Malay relative—variation within sowing boat boards.
